description: This file implements a custom adapter for NextAuth.js using Prisma as the ORM. It provides functions for user and account management, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and session handling, tailored for the CalCom project.

methods.name: parseIntSafe
methods.description: Safely parses a string or number to an integer, throwing an error if invalid.

methods.name: toAdapterUser
methods.description: Transforms a User object from Prisma into an AdapterUser for NextAuth.

methods.name: toAdapterAccount
methods.description: Transforms an Account object from Prisma into an AdapterAccount for NextAuth.

methods.name: createUserData
methods.description: Creates Prisma UserCreateInput data from AdapterUser data.

methods.name: createAccountData
methods.description: Creates Prisma AccountCreateInput data from AdapterAccount.

methods.name: getAccountWhere
methods.description: Constructs a Prisma where clause for account lookup based on provider and providerAccountId.

methods.name: CalComAdapter
methods.description: Main function exporting a Prisma-based adapter implementing NextAuth's Adapter interface.
